# Draft:Anambra Man of the Year (AMTY) Awards

----
The Anambra Man of the Year (AMTY) Awards was established in 2020 to recognize and celebrate individuals of Anambra origin or residents who have made significant contributions to the state's development across various sectors.. The awards aim to uphold excellence, integrity, and societal impact, distinguishing themselves from the commercialization that often plagues similar recognitions.
Ceremonies
First edition (2020)
The maiden edition was launched in 2020 and was Hosted by Vertex View Hotel, Nibo, Awka
Subsequent editions
Since its inception, the AMTY Awards have been held annually, with the 2024 edition marking the fourth installment.  Subsequent editions  including the 2025 ceremony were Hosted by Stanel Dome, Awka.
Categories
* Man of the Year
* Woman of the Year
* Businessman of the Year
* Industrialist of the Year
* Oil and Gas Person of the Year
* Legal Person of the Year
* Philanthropist of the Year
* Public Servant of the Year
* Banker of the Year
* Social Impact Investor of the Year
* Media Person of the Year
* Lifetime Achievement Award
* Music Icon of the Year
* Best Secondary School of the Year
* Most Impactful Person of the Year
Notable Recipients
Over the years, the AMTY Awards have honored numerous individuals who have made significant contributions in their respective fields. Some notable recipients include:
Godwin Maduka — Nigerian-American Medical Doctor and Founder of the Las Vegas Pain Institute and Medical Center; Man of the Year
Cardinal Peter Ebere Okpaleke  — Catholic Prelate; Man of the Year
Prof. Joseph Chukwurah Ezigbo – Managing Director, Falcon Corporation; Man of the Year.
Lady Ada Chukwudozie – Chairperson, Keystone Bank; Woman of the Year.
Prof. Charles Okechukwu Esimone – Former Vice Chancellor, Nnamdi Azikiwe University; Public Servant of the Year.
Prof. Benjamin Ozumba – Former Vice Chancellor, University of Nigeria, Nsukka; Lifetime Achievement Award.
Engr. Barth Nwibe – GMD, Segofs Energy Group; Oil and Gas Person of the Year.
Dr. Valentine Ozigbo — Nigerian Politician: Man of the Year Award
Dr. Prince Donatus Okonkwo – Chairman, Tetrazzini Food Plc.; Iconic Business Leader of the Year.
Ambassador Ajulu Okeke – Nigeria’s First Female Consul-General; Lifetime Achievement Award.
Chief Ugochukwu Okeke – Member, Board of Trustees, PDP; Inspiring Political Leader of the Year.
Prof. P.N. Okeke – Emeritus Professor of Physics; Scientist of the Decade.
Ngozi Ezeonu – Renowned Nollywood actress; Lifetime Achievement Award and Best Actress of the Decade.
Dr. Chinwe Odiegwu – Kays Golden Logistics Service Ltd.; Business Woman of the Year.
Dr. Harry Jeffery – Chairman/CEO, Ocean Growth Homes Ltd.; Real Estate Person of the Year.
Bridget Edokwe – National Publicity Secretary, NBA; Media Person of the Year.
High Chief Azubuike Ekweozor – Philanthropist of the Year.
Rev. Fr. Engr. Chetanna Jude Chukwuneke – Founder, Yadi; Social Impact Investor of the Year.
Dr. Mariette Obianozie Amadi – Founder, 24TeleMed; Diaspora Person of the Year
Emeka Monye – ARISE TV Correspondent; Media Person of the Year.
